logp.method_description: A modified “shake-flask” method was employed to determine the partition coefficients (expressed as logP) of the complexes 1–5 between n-octanol and water following literature procedure [44]. Briefly, a 4 mL solution of the complexes (15, 20 and 25 μM) in n-octanol saturated water was added with 4 mL of water saturated n-octanol and mixed thoroughly in a vortex mixture for ∼ 20 min. The two phases were separated in a centrifuge at an rpm of ∼ 3500 for ∼ 10 min. The concentration of the complexes at each phase was determined using UV–visible spectroscopy. The partition coefficients were calculated using the equation logP = log{[1–5]oct/[1–5]aq}. LogP was calculated as average of three different complex concentrations.
